title: 飞船消失或坠毁
description: 飞船在特定情况下会消失或坠毁，如访问空间站时从气闸处消失、解除对接导致坠毁等，影响玩家使用飞船。
evidence: some more deadlier bugs where your ship will basically crash and be destroyed for no good reason due to bugs in undocking for instance.
Every 1 in 10 station visits, my ship would disappear from the airlock

evidence_items.quote: Every 1 in 10 station visits, my ship would disappear from the airlock
evidence_items.description: 每十次访问空间站约有一次飞船从气闸处消失
evidence_items.quote_zh: 每10次访问空间站，就有1次我的飞船会从气闸舱消失

evidence_items.quote: some more deadlier bugs where your ship will basically crash and be destroyed for no good reason due to bugs in undocking for instance.
evidence_items.description: 因解除对接等bug导致飞船坠毁
evidence_items.quote_zh: 还有一些更致命的bug，比如由于解除对接时的bug，你的飞船基本上会毫无理由地坠毁并被摧毁。
